_comment: Bonsai 2 Ternary (PQ2_0) import, the preferred default when a published ternary GGUF is supplied (target=auto would pick it too). The ternary GGUF must exist already (published weights; TurboForge never trains it). The safetensors directory stays --model for config/tokenizer. If the PQ2_0 GGUF was produced from already-jailbroken weights, TurboForge imports it verbatim and records that prior processing is unverified.
